`interface TransitionDrawing`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.transition` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TransitionDrawing.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/transition/TransitionDrawing.java)

Function that draws a UI for a progress of its transition step, around the body that draws its nodes.

## Description

Give it to [`TransitionStep.draw`](/reference/ui/transitionstep/#TransitionStep-property-draw).
It runs on the render thread, at every frame of the step.

- [Transitions](/use/learn/style-and-motion/transitions/#write-a-transition-of-your-own)

### draw

`void draw(UI ui, float progress, Runnable body)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>
